title: Grace Is Not Permission
devotional: God's grace is not a reason to become careless about sin. Grace gives us mercy, forgiveness, and a new opportunity to walk differently. When you understand grace correctly, you do not use it as an excuse to keep returning to the same destructive pattern. Instead, grace gives you a reason to keep getting back up and choosing obedience. You may not become perfect overnight, but you can become more intentional about the direction of your life. Today, let God's grace move you toward Him, not away from Him.
mind_check: Have you ever used the thought that God will forgive you as an excuse to repeat something you already know is wrong?
body_move: Identify one practical boundary that you need to strengthen instead of relying on the idea that you can always recover afterward.
spirit_move: Thank God for His grace and ask Him to help you respond to that grace with obedience, humility, and a desire to grow.
way_out: Instead of using grace as an excuse to __________, I will respond by __________.
prayer: Father, thank You for Your grace and mercy. Help me never use Your forgiveness as an excuse to remain in patterns that pull me away from You. Teach me to receive grace with gratitude and respond with obedience. When I fall, help me return to You, learn from my mistakes, and keep growing. Amen.
action: Write down one area where you need stronger boundaries. Choose one specific change you will make today as a response to God's grace.
